## next

1. M: Decide `same_sample_id_required`/`same_assay_required`: keys are parsed but
   have no behavioral consumer; honor them or reject non-default values.
2. M: Phase 2 candidates in priority order: sourmash sequence-content comparison,
   reference-aware coverage comparison, processing-aware merged-read checks.
3. M: Recalibrate example thresholds with genuine between-run data before any
   production use (uncalibrated thresholds withhold approval by design).
4. M: Public-flip checklist: drop the internal pixi channel URLs and re-lock,
   scrub or accept the benchmark hostname, apply branch protection (blocked
   while private on a free plan), then flip visibility.
5. L: Profile pysam BAM iteration; per-record access still dominates the scan.

## recommendation

1. M: Treat COMPATIBLE results as technical assessments only; genotype-based
   identity verification (Phase 3) remains necessary for biological claims.
2. L: Add PyPI trusted publishing to the release workflow when the repository
   goes public.
3. L: When calibrating, record the calibration dataset provenance next to the
   policy so `calibrated: true` claims stay auditable.
